calendar_context_only.note: The monetary rule is authoritative in blocks. Calendar duration is derived from the eventual block target; 300 seconds remains a separate research parameter.

manifesto_principles: FAE orients with Bitcoin; it does not mechanically imitate it.
If general-purpose hardware should remain relevant across generations, primary issuance should remain materially available across generations.
Scarcity should be preserved without concentrating most monetary opportunity near genesis.
Subsidy reductions are security-budget events, not only scarcity events.
A 45% reduction preserves strong geometric scarcity while extending the distribution tail relative to a 50% halving.
The authoritative monetary cadence is 630,000 blocks per subsidy era; at the current 300-second research incumbent this is approximately six years.
The 9 FAE starting reward and 630,000-block era produce a natural theoretical ceiling of exactly 12,600,000 FAE before atom-floor effects.
The hard ceiling is 12,600,000 FAE; deterministic atom-flooring may leave a tiny permanently unissued remainder below it.
